jake.s: Quick handoff — ZephyrPilot (acct ZP-983) POC signed. Moving to CS for onboarding. Trial uses Dedicated in us-west2, customer asks for private/VPC evaluation. Trial credits expire in 10 days. Top priorities: Okta SSO, sub-1s tail latency for chat, audit logs/KMS. There's an ENG ticket blocking SSO: ENG-1234. Expected peak ~40 qps. @maria.cs can you take lead on enablement and takeover?

maria.cs: I can take this. Jake, can you confirm SSO contact and whether IdP metadata was uploaded? Also what's the preferred demo flow (chat vs embeddings)?

jake.s: Contact is emily@zephyr.ai. They did upload metadata but saw an assertion error. Demo priority: chat first, then embedding search. Latency is the main concern.

sophie.ops: I'll kick off provisioning checklist: 1) VPC peering request, 2) allocate dedicated pool (A10G preferred), 3) create onboarding workspace + sample corpus, 4) enable audit log retention extension. Any compliance tags?

maria.cs: Tag as "private-deploy-consider". Customer indicates PHI-like data, wants encrypted-at-rest + KMS. Sophie, please request extended audit retention and add KMS integration steps.

liam.eng: Looked into ENG-1234 — assertion failing due to audience mismatch in SAML response. We need the SP EntityID they used. Jake: can Emily paste the raw SAML response or IdP metadata URL? For latency, we observe KV-cache pressure for long contexts causing 95p tails near 1.5-2.5s. Mitigations: enable prefix KV cache, reduce interactive batch size, or fallback to redwood-llama-13b-q2 for chat during peaks as a temporary routing policy.

priya.se: I'll prepare a quick config template and a short enablement deck. Draft config snippet to attach to CS ticket:

```
region: us-west2
deployment:
  type: dedicated
  gpu: a10g
  batch_size: 4
  kv_cache: enabled
network:
  vpc_peering: requested
  sso: saml
  sso_entity_id: https://app.redwood.ai/sp
kms: customer-kms
logging:
  audit_retention_days: 365
```

priya.se: Enablement deck will be ~30m focused on chat latency, fallback policies, and KMS onboarding checklist.

liam.eng: Next steps for ENG ticket: 1) Jake to paste SAML response or IdP metadata by EOD, 2) if SAML fix delayed, use temporary API key for onboarding (logged & rotated) — security needs to approve, 3) ops/infra to provision dedicated pool and I will add a canary route to fallback to 13b for interactive endpoint until KV-cache changes are live.

jake.s: Emily said she
 paste raw SAML tonight. Security approved temporary API key for trial with strict logging.

sophie.ops: Created CS ticket CS-7721 and linked ENG-1234 and PR-5566 for infra provisioning. Owners assigned: maria.cs (CS owner), sophie.ops (ops lead), liam.eng (eng triage), priya.se (enablement).

maria.cs: Scheduling enablement call Tue 10am PT. I'll send calendar invite and onboarding checklist. Sophie: include prerequisites (IdP raw response or metadata, sample dataset, customer contacts, KMS details).

jake.s: 705 Emily confirmed Tue 10am PT.

deploy-bot: Provisioning job PR-5566 started (job id 89012).

maria.cs: CS handoff summary & action items: 1) Run enablement deck Tue 10am, 2) verify SAML assertion with ENG before call, 3) provide onboarding workspace + sample corpus prior to call, 4) confirm KMS integration plan and escalate if blocked. I'll update CS-7721 post-call and close loop.

liam.eng: I'll surface a short latency dashboard link in CS-7721 and watch 95p. If >1s, I'll flip the fallback routing to 13b and notify CS.

priya.se: I'll capture customer feedback in onboarding notes and add a small eval prompt set to monitor quality regressions across models.

jake.s: Thanks team, handing off now. Ping here if anything blocks before Tue.
